title: steps/agentResponse payload
description: Payload for the agentResponse hook. Fires when the agent's response is ready, before reaching the user.

provenance.description: OPTIONAL in the base schema; REQUIRED on every content item under provenance_producer: deterministic (ACS-Provenance). Validate against agent-response.acs-provenance.json when the profile is claimed. See Specification section 7.

reasoning.description: Optional natural-language rationale produced by the agent
